title: Check yourself: Plan or direct, a target to iterate on, and the practice

questions.stem: Which allowed-tools line does the practice accept for the shared review command?

options.says: Ruled out because a bare shell and edit tools are refused: "`Read` and none of `Bash`, `Edit` or `Write` on its own".
A description, `Read`, and a pattern for `git diff`.
Ruled out for its edit tools: "`Read` and none of `Bash`, `Edit` or `Write` on its own".
Ruled out because the line must hold the reading tool: "an `allowed-tools` line that has `Read`".

questions.stem: Which settings pass the practice's check on permissions?

options.says: Ruled out because an edit allow without a path is a whole-tool allow as well: "no allow rule is `Bash`, `Bash(*)`, `Edit` or `Write`".
Ruled out because a whole-tool allow is refused: "no allow rule is `Bash`, `Bash(*)`, `Edit` or `Write`".
Ruled out because the deny rule is required: "The settings pass when `Read(./.env)` is denied".
The environment file is denied and no allow rule approves a whole tool: "no allow rule is `Bash`, `Bash(*)`, `Edit` or `Write`".

questions.stem: Which pair of rows does the practice's modes table need?
